Admission
Apply for Admission
Application Fee
New applicants who have never attended Université Laval: C$101.49
Applicants who have already attended Université Laval, applicants wishing to change programs at the same level or wishing to be admitted into a program at a higher level: C$23.46
Applicants who have registered to non-credited continuing education courses and wishing to be admitted into a regular program: C$101.49
Visiting students (student exchange), training and research interns or postdoctoral fellows wishing to be admitted into a regular program: C$101.49
Your application will not be processed until the application fee is paid. This fee is non-refundable and applies to the targeted semester only, regardless of the number of program choices for that same semester.
Important: if you submit an admission request for a limited enrolment or limited space program, you have to pay the application fee within 5 calendar days following the admission application deadline.
Payment options
Regardless of the place of residence of applicants applying online, we strongly recommend paying by credit card (Visa or MasterCard).
